## Flow Classification Report — ecommerce-microservice-backend-app

### Architecture Summary
Spring Boot microservices with a **proxy-client** acting as the public API gateway (JWT-based auth via `JwtRequestFilter`). Services: user-service, order-service, payment-service, product-service, favourite-service, shipping-service, api-gateway, service-discovery.

Security boundary (from `SecurityConfig`):
- **Public (no auth):** `/api/authenticate/**`, `/api/categories/**`, `/api/products/**`, `/actuator/health/**`
- **ROLE_USER or ROLE_ADMIN:** all other `/api/**` routes
- **ROLE_ADMIN only:** `/actuator/**` (except health/info)

### God Nodes (GRAPH_REPORT.md top-5)
`MavenWrapperDownloader` (13 edges), `Playing With e-Commerce-boot Project` (11), `ApiExceptionHandler` (10), `JwtUtilImpl` (10), `UserDetailsImpl` (9). No HTTP handler node appears in top-5; `JwtUtilImpl` (rank 7) and `UserServiceImpl`/`CredentialServiceImpl` (ranks 12-13) are the most-connected auth-related infrastructure.

### Scoring Notes
- **data_criticality=3** applies broadly: any flow whose reachable subgraph touches Order, Payment, Credential, Address (PII), or VerificationToken entities scores 3 due to the rubric's keyword list (order, payment, credential, token, pii). This elevated 6 out of 8 P0 flows on data_criticality alone.
- **P0 budget cap hit at 8:** `GET /api/users/{userId}` (score 10), `GET /api/orders` (score 11), and `GET /api/payments/{paymentId}` (score 10) all qualify as P0 by score/data_criticality but are downgraded to P1 since P0 slots are exhausted by HARD INCLUDEs and higher-priority write flows.
- **De-duplication applied:** `POST /api/carts` (score 11) merged into `order-create` covers (same order-service DB); `POST /api/credentials` (score 11) merged into `user-register` covers (same user-service DB).
- **No sparsity fallback used:** 71 proxy-client HTTP handler methods identified; graph has sufficient structure.
- **Security flag:** `POST /api/categories` is publicly accessible (no auth required per SecurityConfig) — potential unauthenticated write vulnerability. Deferred with note for security audit.
- **Confidence:** All proxy-client flows rated high confidence; handler nodes verified against source files. Health-check rated high (HARD INCLUDE, standard Spring Boot Actuator).
